title: Verified SDV 1.6 data-asset schemas (for Content Patcher EditData/Load)
source: Shapes proven loadable in the real game (SDV 1.6.15). 'Fields' replace semantics confirmed against Content Patcher EditData docs; machine pair against wiki Modding:Machines / Modding:Big craftables; fish fields against wiki Modding:Fish data; buffs against wiki Modding:Buffs.
rules: content.json 'Format' must be '2.0.0' or newer (never the legacy 1.x version).
Each EditData change must include at least one of: Entries, Fields, MoveEntries, TextOperations.
'Fields' keys: for string-value assets (pipe/caret-delimited) use INTEGER indices ("0", "1", ...). For typed-object assets use the C# property name. Never use a field NAME on a string-value record.

'Fields' REPLACES the named property on an existing entry. Never use Fields to set a list you want to append to (e.g. Data/Locations Fish) — that wipes vanilla entries. Append with TargetField + Entries instead.
'FromFile' is valid ONLY on Load and EditImage, never on EditData.
EditMap MapTiles tiles need 'Position': {"X": .., "Y": ..} and use SetIndex/SetTilesheet (NOT TileIndex/TileSheet).
When-tokens must come from the Content Patcher whitelist (see content_actions.json).
Crafting/cooking recipe ingredients are numeric IDs, qualified IDs, or unique string IDs (390, (O)390, Moss) — never display names (Stone, Iron Bar, CopperOre, Wood, Coal).
Do not emit assets that do not exist in SDV 1.6 (no fictional weather-event or buff-data assets).
A new machine requires BOTH Data/BigCraftables (unqualified id) AND Data/Machines keyed (BC)<id>.
Prefer a minimal change set: one well-formed record beats ten speculative edits.

Data/Weapons.note: Localized name/description go in Strings/UI as Weapon.<id>.Name and Weapon.<id>.Description.

Data/CraftingRecipes.note: Ingredients are IDs not names: 390=Stone, 378=Copper Ore, 388=Wood, 382=Coal. 4th field must be true when the yield is a big craftable.

Data/CookingRecipes.note: 258=Blueberry, 186=Milk. Never use display names as ingredients.

Data/Objects.note: NEVER pipe-delimited strings here — the game rejects them. Typed object required.

Data/Fish.note: Exactly 14 slash-separated fields (indices 0-13). Index 9 (maxDepth) is an INTEGER, never a float. Do not append extra bait tokens.

Data/Locations.note: NEVER use Fields to set Fish — that replaces the entire spawn list and wipes vanilla fish. To append one spawn use TargetField: ["Mountain", "Fish"] with Entries keyed by spawn Id, and ItemId (not FishId).

Data/Characters.note: A brand-new NPC also needs Load for Characters/<id> + Portraits/<id> sprites and Characters/schedules/<id> + Characters/Dialogue/<id> data.

Data/BigCraftables.example: {"Name": "Stone Smelter", "DisplayName": "Stone Smelter", "Description": "Turns stone into gold ore.", "Texture": "TileSheets/Craftables", "SpriteIndex": 13}
Data/BigCraftables.note: The dictionary key is the unqualified item ID (e.g. stone_smelter). A machine also needs a Data/Machines entry keyed (BC)<this id>.

Data/Machines.note: Every Entries key MUST be a qualified big-craftable ID starting with (BC). Pair with Data/BigCraftables. RequiredItemId/ItemId are qualified object IDs like (O)390, never (O)Stone.

Data/Buffs.note: Duration is milliseconds (600000 = 10 minutes). Effects uses skill/stat fields (LuckLevel, Speed, Attack, ...), not Stat/Value/WeatherCondition. A Data/Buffs entry does nothing by itself — apply it via Data/Objects Buffs (food) or Data/TriggerActions AddBuff.

Data/TriggerActions.note: There is no weather-event data asset. Apply a weather buff with Trigger DayStarted, Condition WEATHER Here Rain|Storm|Snow|Wind|Sun (optional SEASON Spring), Actions AddBuff <buffId>, and MarkActionApplied false so it can repeat. EditData Entries key must equal the Id field.

Characters/Dialogue/<NpcName>.note: Target MUST be Characters/Dialogue/<NpcName> (e.g. Characters/Dialogue/Willy). Do not prefix with Data/ — the game does not read Data/Characters/Dialogue/<Npc>.

Characters/schedules/<NpcName>.note: Companion asset Strings/schedules/<NpcName> holds schedule descriptions.

Strings/UI.note: Localized strings; used for Weapon.<id>.Name/.Description, Tool.<id>.Name/.Description and misc UI text.
